text: The logistic-map period-doubling cascade converges geometrically at the universal Feigenbaum constant delta ~ ___ (same for any smooth unimodal map with a quadratic maximum).
explanation: The successive bifurcation gaps shrink by the Feigenbaum ratio delta = (r_n - r_{n-1})/(r_{n+1} - r_n) -> 4.6692..., a universal constant independent of the specific unimodal map.
